title.narrative: Getting Back on the EU Track: Serbia as a Reliable Partner in the Foreign, Security and Defence Policy

description.narrative: Contract related to: Getting Back on the EU Track: Serbia as a Reliable Partner in the Foreign, Security and Defence Policy - The overall objective of the Action is to strengthen participatory democracies and the EU integration and approximation process in Serbia, through an enhanced contribution by civil society and media. For Civil Society, the action will focus on: Improving policy dialogue between the Civil Society and all levels of the government institutions, Increasing capacities and effectiveness of the Serbian Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) to monitor and participate in reform processes and the overall capacities of grassroots movements through flexible financial support to third parties mechanisms in all fields relevant to Serbia¿s accession to the EU. For Media, the action will focus onStrengthening the independent monitoring of the Media strategy of Serbia including enhanced media ethics
